description: Use this when someone asks whether they are in Sade Sati, when their Sade Sati starts or ends, or about Saturn’s seven and a half years. Also use for Shani sade sati and "Saturn’s 7.5 years". Returns whether it is running now, its three phases with dates, and the next one. Needs birth date and town.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: sade_sati_check
title: Sade Sati check
